newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street opens lower with bonds.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street opens lower with bonds.

text.p: Wall Street stocks opened lower on Monday with bonds as investors proved cautious at the start of a week full of economic data and including further Congressional testimony from Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan.
The Dow Jones industrial average was off 11 at 6,865, the Nasdaq Composite down four at 1,305 and the S&P Index off two at 789.
The 30-year long bond was down 15/32 to yield 6.84 percent.
